drafted_brief: Replicate winning campaign CMP-0000469 into underperforming campaign CMP-0000790. Adapt CMP-0000469’s high-performing Apparel Social Q1 creative approach for CMP-0000790’s Apparel Display Q2 placement, preserving the proven winner’s core value proposition, audience cues, offer framing, and visual/creative angle while resizing and tailoring assets for display inventory. Focus on translating the winner’s engagement-driven creative into concise display messaging with a clear CTA, lifestyle-led apparel imagery, and audience targeting aligned to the successful CMP-0000469 segment. Launch as an optimization refresh for CMP-0000790, monitor ROAS, CTR, CPA, and spend efficiency, and compare performance against the current CMP-0000790 baseline ROAS of 1.15.
